title: hasna.skill.v1 portable skill manifest
description: The machine-readable manifest for a portable Hasna skill. Portable metadata lives in skill.json; SKILL.md frontmatter stays minimal (name + description).

name.description: Lowercase slug: letters, numbers, dots, underscores, hyphens. Matches the folder name.

description.description: What this skill does and when to use it.

version.description: Semantic version. Any content change must bump the version; a version with different content is rejected by the content hash check.

runtime.description: Runtime contract: how this skill is executed and what it may touch.
Execution runtime. 'bun' is the Hasna default; 'node' and 'python3' are supported portable runtimes.

version.description: Optional runtime version requirement (e.g. '22', '>=3.12'). Free-form constraint string.

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the runnable entrypoint. Defaults to commands[0].entry.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds, capped at 900.

env.description: Secret REFERENCE names (vault keys / env var names), never values. Uppercase identifiers only.

sandbox.description: Filesystem access granted to execution. Default 'readonly-fs'.

system_deps.description: Allowlisted system binaries the skill requires at execution time.

artifacts.description: Glob patterns of artifacts the skill may produce (e.g. 'out/**', '*.pdf').

provenance.description: Provenance and integrity fields. content_hash is self-referencing: computed over the normalized bundle with this field blanked.

source_commit.description: Git SHA of the source revision this skill was built from, or 'unknown' for locally scaffolded skills.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized skill bundle (manifest without content_hash, line endings normalized, files sorted). See docs/skill-standard.md.

changelog.description: Pointer to changelog or release notes (relative path or URL).
